critical_code_review_comments: Day Book side-placement logic (buildSides) is working: opening-on-right/closing-on-left when account's opening is Cr (overdraft), opening-on-left/closing-on-right otherwise. Totals balance in all cases observed.
LedgerBalanceHint fires /api/ledgers/{id}/balance correctly from both Rokad and Journal entry modals.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted one Rokad jama entry (2026-05-03, 1000, account 301, party AAKASH BARGARH) during active-block regression. Cleanup verified – no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login btn testid is btn-submit (not btn-login). Rokad Nayi Entry btn testid is btn-add-entry. /parties takes ~2-3s to populate select-party inside add-rokad modal — poll until options.length>2. Day Book sheet is always visible for print (print:block on sheet wrapper, print:hidden on list wrapper), confirmed via page.emulate_media('print').
